q: What is the minimum floor area of each hemodialysis station?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex F (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), items 1.2 and 2.6
n: 6 m² per station, dimensioned 2.00 m × 3.00 m. Remember this: a dialysis station is a "2 × 3 = 6" box. Water treatment room 12–15 sq. m. Treatment room door 1.12 m (3'-8"), better a 1.80 m pair. 24°C (75°F) and 6 air changes. Windows = 10% of floor area. Word root: hemodialysis = Greek haima "blood" + dialysis "separating".

q: What are the prescribed dimensions of a hemodialysis station?
What is the floor area range of the water treatment room?
n: Space for equipment, tanks and maintenance.

q: What is the minimum clear width of the entrance door to the HD treatment room?
n: At least 1.12 m; a two-leaf door with 1.80 m (6 ft) total is preferred.

q: What is the recommended temperature of the HD treatment room?
n: 75°F ≈ 24°C, with at least 6 total air changes per hour.

q: What is the minimum total air changes per hour in the HD treatment room?
n: Six total air changes per hour.

q: Rooms of a dialysis clinic without mechanical ventilation need windows with a free area of at least what percentage of the floor area?
n: Windows ≥ 10% of the floor area, opening to a court, yard, street or alley.

q: What minimum floor-to-ceiling height applies to a dialysis clinic in general?
n: At least 2.40 m; higher is preferred in the treatment area for TV monitors and indirect lighting.

q: What recommended illumination applies to the nurse station DESK and medication area?
ref: DOH AO 2016-0042, Annex F (Rev. 00, 12/14/2016), item 3.0 no. 12 (illumination table)
n: Nurse station general 300 lux; desk and medication area 500 lux; treatment area 300 lux.

q: What must separate the reception section from the dialysis service complex?
o: A control door wide enough for a wheelchair or stretcher
n: Entry to the treatment complex is restricted to HD staff and patients.

q: Where should the emergency generator room be located?
o: "Zoned" away from the HD treatment section, with acoustic insulation if needed
n: Keeps genset noise away from patients and restricts access.

q: Under the revised HD checklist (DC 2019-0377), what minimum waiting area per companion applies?
n: Waiting area commensurate to companions at 0.65 m² each.
